description: Master figure manifest for perch-hoplite repo

gradio_30s_context_dolphin.png.caption: Pacific white-sided dolphin call (April 20 2018, 205-210s, score=0.147): structured vertical call features spanning 2-12 kHz in the 5-second linear STFT. The 30-second mel context shows an acoustically active environment. dolphin_call selected (blue button).
gradio_30s_context_dolphin.png.command: nohup python3 phase2_classify.py review --db-dir /mnt/PAM_Analysis/perch-hoplite/db/MARS_20180401_20180430_32kHz_norm --classifier /mnt/PAM_Analysis/perch-hoplite/models/orca_v2.pt --target-label orca_call --detections-csv /tmp/dolphin_clip.csv --num-results 1 --classes orca_call,humpback_song,dolphin_call,ship_noise,other,unlabeled --audio-dir /mnt/PAM_Analysis/GoogleMultiSpeciesWhaleModel2/resampled_32kHz/2018/04 --spectrogram-type linear --serve --port 7864

gradio_30s_context_orca2.png.caption: Orca call confirmed (April 13 2018, MARS_20180413_075913, 370-375s, score=3.308, UTC ~08:05): 5-second linear STFT showing structured broadband call energy entering at 4s, spanning 2-10 kHz. The 30-second mel context shows the hunt in full swing. orca_call selected (green button). Classifier: orca_v2.
gradio_30s_context_orca2.png.command: nohup python3 phase2_classify.py review --db-dir /mnt/PAM_Analysis/perch-hoplite/db/MARS_20180401_20180430_32kHz_norm --classifier /mnt/PAM_Analysis/perch-hoplite/models/orca_v2.pt --target-label orca_call --detections-csv /tmp/single_clip.csv --num-results 1 --classes orca_call,humpback_song,dolphin_call,ship_noise,other,unlabeled --audio-dir /mnt/PAM_Analysis/GoogleMultiSpeciesWhaleModel2/resampled_32kHz/2018/04 --spectrogram-type linear --serve --port 7862

gradio_30s_context_orca2_viridis.png.caption: Orca call confirmed (April 13 2018, MARS_20180413_075913, 370-375s, score=3.308, UTC ~08:05): 5-second mel spectrogram viridis (top), 30-second mel context viridis (bottom). orca_call selected (green button). Classifier: orca_v2.
gradio_30s_context_orca2_viridis.png.command: nohup python3 phase2_classify.py review --db-dir /mnt/PAM_Analysis/perch-hoplite/db/MARS_20180401_20180430_32kHz_norm --classifier /mnt/PAM_Analysis/perch-hoplite/models/orca_v2.pt --target-label orca_call --detections-csv /tmp/single_clip.csv --num-results 1 --classes orca_call,humpback_song,dolphin_call,ship_noise,other,unlabeled --audio-dir /mnt/PAM_Analysis/GoogleMultiSpeciesWhaleModel2/resampled_32kHz/2018/04 --spectrogram-type mel --colormap viridis --serve --port 7863

gradio_30s_context_humpback.png.caption: Humpback song (October 2020): the 30-second mel context reveals the repeating low-frequency phrase structure diagnostic of humpback song — entirely invisible in the 5-second clip alone. Yellow markers locate the 5-second window within the broader context.
gradio_30s_context_humpback.png.notes: Captured July 7 2026 on ICEFISH. Exact WAV file and offset unknown — commit 93c25bf.

tsne_apr2018_oct2020_norm.png.caption: Perch V2 embeddings t-SNE — April 2018 + October 2020 (normalized). 778 labeled embeddings, 6 classes. Orca (green) forms a tight cluster. Humpback (orange) spans two regions confirming dual acoustic cluster. Ship noise (cyan) and background (gray) tightly isolated.
tsne_apr2018_oct2020_norm.png.command: python3 tools/plot_tsne.py --db-dir /mnt/PAM_Analysis/perch-hoplite/db/MARS_20180401_20180430_32kHz_norm /mnt/PAM_Analysis/perch-hoplite/db/MARS_20201001_20201031_32kHz_norm --output /mnt/PAM_Analysis/perch-hoplite/results/tsne_apr2018_oct2020_norm.png --title 'Perch V2 Embeddings — April 2018 + October 2020 (normalized)'

tsne_apr2018_oct2020_apr2026_norm.png.caption: Perch V2 embeddings t-SNE — April 2018 + October 2020 + April 2026 (normalized). 823 labeled embeddings, 6 classes, 3 seasons. Orca cluster consistent across all seasons. 25 April 2026 humpback hard-negatives land in humpback cluster confirming correct labels.
tsne_apr2018_oct2020_apr2026_norm.png.command: python3 tools/plot_tsne.py --db-dir /mnt/PAM_Analysis/perch-hoplite/db/MARS_20180401_20180430_32kHz_norm /mnt/PAM_Analysis/perch-hoplite/db/MARS_20201001_20201031_32kHz_norm /mnt/PAM_Analysis/perch-hoplite/db/MARS_20260401_20260430_32kHz_norm --output /mnt/PAM_Analysis/perch-hoplite/results/tsne_apr2018_oct2020_apr2026_norm.png --title 'Perch V2 Embeddings — April 2018 + October 2020 + April 2026 (normalized)'
